provenance.note: The Faust damage reduction follows the official English description; the scraped Japanese variant has the opposite sign.

messages.-最大値:11\n-連携を実施した黒獣によって鴻園の君主ホンルが強化される\n-:
Maximum: 11
Empowers The Lord of Hongyuan Hong Lu according to the Heishou that performed the coordinated action. These effects stack.
- Heishou Pack - Mao Branch Adept Faust: take -5% skill damage.
- Heishou Pack - Mao Branch Ryōshū: deal +5% damage if faster than the target.
- Heishou Pack - Mao Branch Outis: inflict +1 Rupture Count On Hit with Unopposed Attacks (1 time per turn).
- Heishou Pack - Si Branch Rodion: inflict 1 Rupture On Critical Hit (3 times per turn).
- Heishou Pack - Si Branch Gregor: gain +1 Poise Count when dealing Rupture damage (1 time per turn).
